dict.string: MemeMe uses the camera only while its panel is open, to match your expression and to take the photos or GIFs of you that you copy. Nothing leaves your Mac unless you paste it.
MemeMe indexes images on your Desktop, including screenshots, so you can find your memes by face or by words. Files stay where they are and nothing leaves your Mac.
MemeMe looks for memes in Documents only when you ask it to. Files stay where they are and nothing leaves your Mac.
MemeMe indexes images in Downloads so you can find memes you saved by face or by words. Files stay where they are and nothing leaves your Mac.
MemeMe indexes images in folders you add to it. Files stay where they are and nothing leaves your Mac.
MemeMe. Runs entirely on your Mac.
